summary.name: Selfgazer
summary.one_liner: Selfgazer is a self-exploration site offering Jungian-framed tarot readings, birth chart analysis, I Ching consultations, and an AI-style "Oracle" companion for esoteric and astrological insight.
use_cases: Exploring personal psychology through tarot symbolism
Reviewing a weekly outlook based on planetary contacts to a birth chart
Getting perspective on life changes via I Ching
Comparing astrological charts for relationship compatibility
Reading a BaZi Four Pillars chart and ten-year life chapters
Building a self-reflection or esoteric study practice
summary.what_it_does: Selfgazer provides several divination and self-reflection tools: birth chart analysis that examines planetary patterns at the time of birth, a weekly outlook listing dated planetary contacts to the user's chart, guided tarot readings, and guided I Ching consultations. It also offers synastry (chart comparison) for relationships and a Chinese astrology reading of Four Pillars (BaZi). The Selfgazer Oracle is described as a conversational companion that combines multiple traditions, supports follow-up questions, and includes emotional check-ins. The site states its astrological calculations use the Swiss Ephemeris engine. It also links to learning resources on introspection and esoteric systems.
notable: Calculations powered by the Swiss Ephemeris engine
Jungian psychology framing for tarot, astrology and I Ching
Weekly outlook with dated planetary contacts to the user's birth chart
Includes BaZi Four Pillars Chinese astrology reading
caveats: Explicitly states it cannot diagnose or treat mental health conditions
Pricing and free tier details are not stated on the page (the directory listing tags it #free, but the page itself does not confirm this)
